messages:
Priya S: Hey people-ops — putting Samir K (PM) on a condensed first-week plan. Mostly set but running into access gaps: Samir doesn't see our GitHub org repos and Okta shows no provisioning yet. Can folks help verify group membership and Okta sync? Need core access by EOD tomorrow if possible. TL;DR agenda + 30/60/90 sketch below, plus list of required accounts.

Priya S: ```
Day 1: HR intro, benefits + payroll setup, laptop handoff
Day 2: Engineering onboarding, GitHub access, repo walkthrough
Day 3: Product sync, first 30-day goals, set up eval prompts
Week 1: shadowings, access to staging, join oncall channel (read-only)
30/60/90 bullets: 30d = learn infra & product; 60d = lead small feature; 90d = own roadmap slice
Required: Okta, GitHub org membership (org: redwood-inc), Slack, VPN, JIRA project permissions
```

Priya S: Samir's info: full name Samir Khanna, email samir.khanna@example.com, start 2024-07-22.

Alex M: Thanks Priya! I'm on it — pinging IT and HR. @it-support can you confirm Okta provisioning queue? Also please add Samir to the "product-pm" JIRA group. :pray:

IT Support: Received — I see a pending Okta invite for samir.khanna@example.com but it hasn't been accepted. We can re-send and escalate automatic provisioning. Re-sent invite at 1718001242. Can you confirm Samir's preferred laptop (macOS vs linux)?

Priya S: confirmed macOS M1 preferred. Also re-sent invite seen on my side, thanks.

Elaine H: Payroll & benefits note: Samir still needs to complete the new-hire form (I sent the link earlier). I can extend the equipment survey invite again — expect to see an email from people-ops@redwood.com.

Devex Bot: For GitHub org invite, engineering can use this quick script to re-invite and set team membership: 

```
# invite and add to team
gh api orgs/redwood-inc/invitations -f invitee_id=$(gh user view samir.khanna --json id -q .id)
gh api orgs/redwood-inc/teams/product-pm/memberships --raw-field role=member -F username=samir.khanna
```

Devex Bot: If you don't have the GH CLI, let me know and I can trigger a manual invite.

IT Support: GitHub invite sent at 1718001250 (manual invite). Okta re-provisioning started, ETA ~2 hours. VPN profile will be provisioned after Okta completes.

Samir K: Thanks all — excited to join! I accepted the Okta invite and replied to the equipment survey. Quick Q: who should I ping for VPN troubleshooting if the profile doesn't show up?

IT Support: @Samir K ping me here (IT Support) or open a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk. We'll prioritize since you're on the onboarding path.

Alex M: I'll follow up end-of-day to confirm everything is green. Priya — do you want a 30-minute check-in on Friday to adjust week 1 goals?

Priya S: Yes please — put it on the calendar. Appreciate the quick turnaround team :thumbsup:
